xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Notes on Standalone Financial Results
1. The above financials results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 7th November, 2026. The statutory auditors of the company have given an unmodified limited review report on these financial results, pursuant to Regulation 33 of SEBI(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

2. The SRL Employees Stock Option Scheme-2018 and the SRL Employees Stock Option Scheme-2021 have been completed. Cumulatively up to 30th September, 2026, 35,29,275 Stock Options were exercised under these Schemes (Nil during the quarter), and an equal number of Equity Shares of Rs. 5/- each were transferred to the employees from the Surya Roshni Employees Welfares Trust. The Trust has transferred or sold all 49,46,800 Equity Shares of Rs. 5/- each (post-bonus) it held, and holds no shares as on 30th September, 2026. So no Treasury Shares are shown as a deduction from Equity under Ind AS 32 'Financial Instruments Presentation' for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026.

3. Previous Period figures are regrouped /reclassified wherever necessary.
